# netbox_location (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/sites-and-racks/#locations):

> Racks and devices can be grouped by location within a site. A location may represent a floor, room, cage, or similar organizational unit. Locations can be nested to form a hierarchy. For example, you may have floors within a site, and rooms within a floor.

Each location must have a name that is unique within its parent site and location, if any.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_site" "test" {
  name = "test"
}

resource "netbox_tenant" "test" {
  name = "test"
}

resource "netbox_location" "test" {
  name        = "test"
  description = "my description"
  site_id     = netbox_site.test.id
  tenant_id   = netbox_tenant.test.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the location.
- `site_id` (Number) The ID of the site associated with the location.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the location.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the location.
- `facility` (String) The facility of the location.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the location. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `parent_id` (Number) The ID of the parent associated with the location.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the location.
- `status` (String) One of [planned, staging, active, decommissioning, retired].
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the location.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the location was created.
- `device_count` (Number) The number of device objects that refer to the location.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the location was last changed.
- `prefix_count` (Number) The number of prefix objects that refer to the location.
- `rack_count` (Number) The number of rack objects that refer to the location.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_location.example 1
```
